title: DashboardPipeline
wrapsNative: NavigationStack with navigationTitle and a toolbar (a New button, a Picker for the period, a Toggle for arrange mode), ScrollView, LazyVGrid of MonarchStatCard for the figures, MonarchInsightStrip, and MonarchDashboardGrid of MonarchFunnelChart, MonarchWidget, MonarchEventChip, MonarchBarList, MonarchLeaderboard and MonarchActivityTimeline sections; LabeledContent with .labeledContentStyle(.monarch) for list rows
summary: A recipe, not a component: the home screen of a pipeline product (deals, candidates, campaigns), with key figures, insights and a grid of sections for the pipeline by stage, today's agenda, what is waiting on the person, what is coming up, performance, a ranking and recent activity.
whenToUse: For the first screen of a product where work moves through stages and people plan their day around it, such as a sales CRM or a recruiting tool. On iPad the same grid shows two or three columns.
whenNotToUse: For a product that watches live work and incidents, use the dashboard-operational recipe. For one stage board, use a list or a board screen rather than a home screen.
api: NavigationStack { ScrollView { VStack { LazyVGrid(columns:spacing:) { MonarchStatCard(…) }; MonarchInsightStrip(_:insights:); MonarchDashboardGrid(_:layout:itemLabel:span:isEditing:labels:content:) } }.navigationTitle(_:).toolbar { … } }

MonarchDashboardGrid content: MonarchFunnelChart(_:stages:description:onSelect:) for the pipeline; MonarchWidget { MonarchEventChip(_:time:variant:action:) } for today; MonarchWidget(_:onViewAll:content:) with LabeledContent rows for follow-ups and upcoming; MonarchWidget { MonarchBarList(_:items:) } for performance; MonarchWidget { MonarchLeaderboard(…) } for top performers; the activity-widget recipe for recent activity

.toolbar { ToolbarItem(placement: .primaryAction) { Button(_:systemImage:action:) }; ToolbarItem(placement: .secondaryAction) { Picker("Period", selection:content:) }; ToolbarItem(placement: .secondaryAction) { Toggle(_:systemImage:isOn:) } }

options.name: sections
options.type: An Identifiable enum of the app's sections
options.description: One case per section, with a title for the grid's labels and a MonarchDashboardGridSpan for wide screens (pipeline and performance two columns, the rest one). Leave a case out and the grid closes up.

options.name: layout
options.description: The person's saved order of section ids, passed to MonarchDashboardGrid; empty keeps the default order. Store it per person.

options.name: isEditing
options.description: Arrange mode, from the toolbar toggle: each section gets move buttons.

options.name: period
options.description: The period chosen in the toolbar; the app reloads the figures and sections for it.

options.name: onSelect (funnel)
options.description: Opens the deals in a stage when a funnel stage is chosen.

states.name: phone
states.description: One column: the figures two across (one across at accessibility text sizes), the insights, then each section full width in the saved order.

states.name: iPad
states.description: From 640 points of grid width MonarchDashboardGrid shows two columns and from the wide breakpoint three; sections keep their spans.

states.name: arrange
states.description: With the Arrange toggle on, MonarchDashboardGrid shows move buttons on each section and reports the new order through layout.

states.name: loading
states.description: MonarchFunnelChart with status .loading keeps its height; MonarchStatCard with isLoading shows placeholder figures; MonarchWidget state .loading for the other sections.

states.name: empty
states.description: A day with nothing scheduled uses MonarchWidget state .empty with its own message.

states.name: error
states.description: MonarchLeaderboard with errorMessage and onRetry, or MonarchWidget state .failed, shows Try again in that section only.

appearance: The canvas is the screen background; figures, sections and charts are Monarch cards on the surface colour with their own borders, funnel stages and bars use the chart colours, today's events use the event-chip bar and overdue items a danger badge with an icon. The navigation bar and toolbar are the system ones; every part follows light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ships DashboardPipeline as one component with section slots (pipeline, today, followUps, upcoming, performance, leaders, activity), a header with scope, period and actions, a KPIRow, an InsightStrip and a DashboardGrid. On iOS it is a recipe: the title goes to the navigation bar, the period and the primary action go to the toolbar, and the app lists its sections as an enum for MonarchDashboardGrid, which is one column on a phone. The pipeline section is MonarchFunnelChart itself, because the chart frame is already a card. The web's today slot is a TodayPanel; here it is MonarchEventChip rows in a MonarchWidget, as in the today-panel recipe. The web's headingLevel has no equivalent because navigation titles and section headings are set by the system. Android has no entry for this template yet.
accessibility: The screen title is the navigation bar title, which VoiceOver reads as the screen's heading; each section's title is a heading from MonarchWidget or the chart frame.
The figures are a group named "Key figures" and each MonarchStatCard is read as its label, value and change, with the change direction spoken, not shown by colour alone.
MonarchFunnelChart reads each stage with its value and the rate from the previous stage; choosing a stage is a button action.
Overdue follow-ups carry a badge with a clock icon and the word Overdue, not colour alone.
MonarchDashboardGrid is named "Dashboard sections"; in arrange mode each section has Move earlier and Move later buttons and custom actions, and each move is announced with the new position.
Period and Arrange are toolbar controls with text labels; Arrange is a toggle, so VoiceOver reads its state.
At accessibility text sizes the figures fall back to one column, and the grid is one column on a phone at every size.
edgeCases: With no sections, leave MonarchDashboardGrid out and show MonarchEmptyState instead of an empty grid.
A funnel with one stage shows no rates; with no stages use status .empty.
Large currency values in the figures use isCompact on MonarchStatCard so they fit two across.
A saved layout that names a section the app no longer shows is ignored by MonarchDashboardGrid; new sections are added at the end.
